name: Response Status 2 Code
definition: Specifies the status of the received collateral message (collateral claim, a collateral proposal or a proposal/request for collateral substitution) from a collateral management perspective.

CONF.name: Confirmed
CONF.definition: Collateral giver instruction details are confirmed.

DKNY.name: Not Recognised
DKNY.definition: Collateral giver instruction details are not recognised.
